from openpyxl import load_workbook, Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import date, timedelta
import hashlib, json

workspace = Path("/workspace")
source = workspace / "leads.xlsx"
xlsx_out = workspace / "follow-up-plan.xlsx"
md_out = workspace / "customer-message-draft.md"

wb_in = load_workbook(source, data_only=True)
ws_in = wb_in["线索"]
headers = [c.value for c in ws_in[1]]
required = ["客户", "阶段", "金额", "下一步"]
if headers[:4] != required:
    raise ValueError(f"字段不匹配: {headers[:4]}")

records = []
for row in ws_in.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    if not any(v is not None for v in row[:4]):
        continue
    customer, stage, amount, next_step = row[:4]
    if not customer or not stage or amount is None or not next_step:
        raise ValueError(f"存在不完整记录: {row[:4]}")
    records.append({"客户": str(customer), "阶段": str(stage), "金额": float(amount), "下一步": str(next_step)})

if not records:
    raise ValueError("未发现可用线索记录")

priority_map = {"商务": "高", "方案": "中", "线索": "常规"}
days_map = {"商务": 1, "方案": 2, "线索": 3}
owner_action = {
    "确认合同": "准备合同要点与待确认条款，提交内部复核后再联系客户",
    "安排演示": "确认演示范围、参会人和候选时间，内部确认后再联系客户",
    "首次访谈": "准备需求访谈提纲与候选时间，内部确认后再联系客户",
}
today = date.today()

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "跟进计划"
out_headers = ["客户", "阶段", "金额", "下一步", "优先级", "建议跟进日期", "内部准备事项", "CRM写入状态", "外部发送状态"]
ws.append(out_headers)
for r in records:
    ws.append([
        r["客户"], r["阶段"], r["金额"], r["下一步"],
        priority_map.get(r["阶段"], "常规"),
        today + timedelta(days=days_map.get(r["阶段"], 3)),
        owner_action.get(r["下一步"], "准备跟进材料，内部确认后再联系客户"),
        "待HUMMER受控动作审批/执行",
        "未发送（草稿）",
    ])

navy = "1F4E78"
light = "D9EAF7"
thin = Side(style="thin", color="B7C9D6")
for cell in ws[1]:
    cell.font = Font(color="FFFFFF", bold=True)
    cell.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=navy)
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
for row in ws.iter_rows():
    for cell in row:
        cell.border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)
        cell.alignment = Alignment(vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
for cell in ws["C"][1:]:
    cell.number_format = '¥#,##0'
for cell in ws["F"][1:]:
    cell.number_format = "yyyy-mm-dd"
widths = [16, 10, 14, 16, 10, 16, 44, 28, 20]
for i, width in enumerate(widths, 1):
    ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = width
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
ws.auto_filter.ref = ws.dimensions

summary = wb.create_sheet("汇总")
summary.append(["指标", "值"])
summary.append(["线索数", len(records)])
summary.append(["总金额", sum(r["金额"] for r in records)])
summary.append(["说明", "本文件仅为草稿；CRM写入与外部发送均须通过HUMMER受控动作。"])
for cell in summary[1]:
    cell.font = Font(color="FFFFFF", bold=True)
    cell.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=navy)
for row in summary.iter_rows():
    for cell in row:
        cell.border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)
        cell.alignment = Alignment(vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
summary["B3"].number_format = '¥#,##0'
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 18
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 72
wb.save(xlsx_out)

lines = [
    "# 客户跟进消息草稿",
    "",
    "> 仅供内部审核。以下内容尚未外部发送；发送前须通过 HUMMER 受控动作审批与执行。",
    "",
]
for r in records:
    if r["下一步"] == "安排演示":
        body = "您好，我们已根据前期沟通整理好方案。想与您确认一次产品演示的参会人、重点范围及合适时间。请问您近期哪些时段方便？"
    elif r["下一步"] == "确认合同":
        body = "您好，关于双方正在推进的合作合同，我们希望与您确认关键条款及后续签署安排。待内部复核完成后，我们会提供待确认事项清单。"
    elif r["下一步"] == "首次访谈":
        body = "您好，为更准确地了解贵司需求，我们想安排一次首次需求访谈，重点了解业务目标、当前流程和期望时间。请问您近期哪些时段方便？"
    else:
        body = f"您好，想就“{r['下一步']}”与您进一步沟通。待内部确认后，我们再与您约定具体安排。"
    lines += [
        f"## {r['客户']}",
        "",
        f"- 当前阶段：{r['阶段']}",
        f"- 关联金额：¥{r['金额']:,.0f}",
        f"- 建议下一步：{r['下一步']}",
        "",
        body,
        "",
        "**控制状态：未发送；仅为草稿。**",
        "",
    ]
lines += [
    "## HUMMER 受控动作提案",
    "",
    "- CRM 写入：待人工审批后，将《跟进计划》中的建议日期、下一步及内部准备事项写入对应客户记录。",
    "- 外部发送：待人工审核客户、渠道、收件人和最终文案后，由受控动作通道发送；不得由本沙箱直接发送。",
    "",
]
md_out.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")

# Re-open and validate final artifacts.
check = load_workbook(xlsx_out, data_only=True)
assert check["跟进计划"].max_row == len(records) + 1
assert check["跟进计划"].max_column == len(out_headers)
assert "未发送（草稿）" in [check["跟进计划"].cell(i, 9).value for i in range(2, len(records) + 2)]
md_text = md_out.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for r in records:
    assert r["客户"] in md_text
assert "未发送" in md_text and "受控动作" in md_text

def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps({
    "source_records": len(records),
    "source_total_amount": int(sum(r["金额"] for r in records)),
    "artifacts": [
        {"path": str(xlsx_out), "sha256": digest(xlsx_out), "sizeBytes": xlsx_out.stat().st_size},
        {"path": str(md_out), "sha256": digest(md_out), "sizeBytes": md_out.stat().st_size},
    ],
    "validation": "passed",
    "controlled_actions": {"crm_write": "not_performed", "external_send": "not_performed"}
}, ensure_ascii=False))
